search_lead.cognate: Armenian tesanem and Greek derkomai continue *derḱ-; Armenian ačʻkʻ and Greek ophthalmos denote eyes, with the Greek eye formation requiring separate etymological scrutiny.
search_lead.argument: Armenian աչաւք … տեսանէին has the same instrumental organ + seeing construction as the Greek finds.
